pins.finding: Rejects InsufficientEvidence and verifies nonempty complete original retention membership. A known Ineligible observation can be read.
Authenticates original Product/Qualification/execution evidence, rejects unknown disposition values, and sets each checked member qualified from its original decision.
Before this patch, returned Checked.qualified from primary.qualified alone after authenticating retention evidence.
Before this patch, Model used that primary-only admission flag; Selector authenticated the full body but did not independently require every retention member to be qualified.
The actual fixture reads real original B/retention owners and preserves Ineligible. It does not establish a positive ordinary profile.
The fixture reuses the original frozen metric roles/sources for primary and retention; it does not supply a distinct noninferiority retention criterion.
Fixture task-success is Maximize with PrimarySuperiority margin zero and DoublyRobust source; no separate NonInferiority role.

old_gap: Authentication of retention evidence was not the same as satisfaction of its acceptance rule. A primary-qualified result alone could reach positive Model admission even when a retention qualification was Ineligible.
new_rule: After full original evidence verification and complete nonempty membership checks, positive admission requires every checked member to be qualified. No unregistered alternative criterion is inferred.

cases.model_and_selector: may proceed only if all remaining original identity, currentness and owner checks also succeed

cases.observation: existing original validation rejects; not converted into NoUpdate

cases.retention: missing, duplicate, unregistered, unknown, expired or inconsistent

interpretation: Ineligible can mean insufficient proof of superiority and does not by itself establish a regression.
A read-only observation is not adoption, a retained-capability certificate, or a rollback.
The patch neither re-signs a primary receipt nor changes a frozen metric/threshold or an already persisted Model/Version record.
Existing fixture credentials, declared Product metadata and future B clock remain explicit mechanisms; they are not ordinary production authorization.
The all-real positive qualified-E to Model/Version effect chain remains unverified.
